proposals.title: Honest spatial-join help matching within / intersects / nearest
proposals.summary: analysis/spatial-join.md still documents Contains, Within distance, one-to-many cardinality, and default all-fields joins. spatialJoinGenerator only accepts predicate within|intersects|nearest (optional nearestMaxMeters), attributeStrategy count|first, attrsToKeep (required for first), and attrPrefix; comments explicitly refuse cartesian one-to-many. Rewrite help to match the generator and builder SpatialJoinStepEditor.
proposals.rationale: Same class of analysis help lie as dissolve/fishnet/contour in cycle 7. Demo authors reading help will configure options that do not exist.
proposals.risk: Do not invent contains or cartesian join in this PR. Document count vs first attribute strategies; point near-distance filtering at spatial-filter when needed; CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about what we are not. Prefer documented PostGIS join shapes over fake Esri Spatial Join parity.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite spatial-join.md Inputs/Output/Examples to within|intersects|nearest + count|first attrs; remove Contains / Within distance / one-to-many claims; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Honest group-by help matching aggregate ST_Union + ops
proposals.summary: analysis/group-by.md advertises geometry strategies Drop / Bounding box / Convex hull / First / Dissolve and aggregates last / collect_into_array. The shipped tool is aggregate: groupBy + aggs (count|sum|avg|min|max|first only) with geometry always ST_Union per group. Builder label is Group by + aggregate. Align help with aggregateGenerator and AggregateStepEditor.
proposals.rationale: Highest-visibility remaining analysis help oversell after spatial-join. Authors who pick Drop or collect_into_array from the page will not find those controls.
proposals.risk: Keep keyed dissolve redirect from dissolve.md accurate. Do not invent geometry-strategy params; say output geometry is always the union of each group; CHANGELOG docs note.
proposals.ethosFit: Docs match the free PostGIS group-by you actually get. No fake ModelBuilder aggregate palette.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite group-by.md Inputs/Output to groupBy + count/sum/avg/min/max/first and ST_Union geometry; drop strategy / last / collect_into_array claims; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Honest Calculate help: expression dialect vs calculate-geometry
proposals.summary: analysis/calculate.md and reference/expression-language.md Geometry helpers (area_m2, length_m, centroid_*, bbox_*) claim Calculate-step support. packages/shared-types expression FUNCTIONS has no those names; area/length/perimeter live on calculate-geometry as measurement + unit + fieldName. Rewrite Calculate help to {{field}} expressions only and point geometry measures at the Calculate geometry step (and optional Analyze follow-up later).
proposals.rationale: Third honesty bug in the same sweep. Expression docs that invent helpers burn support when authors paste area_m2() into calculate-field.
proposals.risk: Keep filter / calculate-field vocabulary accurate; explicitly say geometry helpers are not in the expression dialect; cross-link calculate-geometry; CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about the free expression dialect and the separate PostGIS geometry measure tool.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Strip geometry-helper sections from calculate.md and expression-language.md; document calculate-geometry measurement/unit/fieldName; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Extract query-builder chrome into en/es/fr/de/pt-BR analyzeWorkbench.* catalogs with t() calls; What's new optional (i18n-only can skip).

proposals.title: Guided Convex hull shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: convexHullGenerator is no-param like centroid. Analyze has no Convex hull for this layer control and help has no convex-hull.md. Mirror AnalyzeCentroidGuide: POST a single-step convex-hull derived_layer, label as server job, add help/analysis/convex-hull.md.
proposals.rationale: Cheap Analyze honesty win after Simplify. Esri Minimum Bounding Geometry / Convex Hull seat pain maps onto free PostGIS ST_ConvexHull without a second layer picker.
proposals.risk: Users may expect one hull for the whole layer. Generator is per-feature hull with attributes unchanged; say so in UI and help. Reuse existing worker path and i18n pattern from Centroid.
proposals.ethosFit: Free-at-point-of-use analysis on your hardware. Guided PostGIS over proprietary geoprocessing seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-convex-hull-guide POSTing single-step convex-hull derived_layer; add help/analysis/convex-hull.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Guided Densify shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: densifyGenerator already takes maxSegmentLength + unit (Simplify/Buffer-shaped). Analyze has no Densify this layer control and help has no densify.md. Mirror AnalyzeSimplifyGuide: short form, POST single-step densify derived_layer, label as server job.
proposals.rationale: Next parameterized Analyze shortcut after Simplify. Meter-honest densify on PostGIS without a desktop seat; pairs with simplify for generalize workflows Felt/AGO charge for.
proposals.risk: Tolerance unit confusion (degrees vs meters). Reuse Buffer/Simplify unit conversion honesty and generator max segment meters; document ST_Segmentize on geography.
proposals.ethosFit: Free densify on your PostGIS. Prefer honest meter units over degree traps.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-densify-guide + help/analysis/densify.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Honest point-cloud help and viewer copy for size-aware streaming tiers
proposals.summary: item-types.md says point clouds stream only the part in view with no caveat. Size-aware tiers (default / huge / ultra budgets, debounce, picking off) and deferLidarUpdatesWhileMoving already ship as local mitigations under #183; help never names them. Add a short help page (or tile-layer / item-types section) plus a one-line viewer note when huge/ultra tiers engage. Do not claim Tile3D / SSE LOD / incremental nodes; do not close #183.
proposals.rationale: Playbook allows incremental #183 progress that stays honest. Docs that promise Potree-smooth streaming on 200M COPC set false expectations after the WV hang write-up.
proposals.risk: Keep tone mitigation-not-fix. Do not bump maplibre-gl-lidar or rewrite the renderer. No Tile3D conversion path. What's new only if the viewer chip is user-visible.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about what we are not (not Potree/Cesium yet). Local knobs stay labeled as density/responsiveness tradeoffs.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Document default/huge/ultra streaming tiers and picking/debounce tradeoffs in help; surface a muted viewer note when tier != default; CHANGELOG docs note; leave #183 open.
